value.title: Phase 1: workstream docs (docs-system)
value.summary: The pij/workstream schema, the skill's workstream procedure, PRD 001 and blueprint 001 wording and rows, and v3 of the six core templates. No folder moves.

value.title: The pij/workstream schema and its fixtures
value.success: `.dd/schemas/pij/workstream` validates steps with id, state, plan, delivers, builds, needs and depends_on (cross-file), plus part_of (cross-file) and lanes (branch required; worktree and stream optional). pij/roadmap stays, its description marked superseded.

value.title: workstream.md, the roadmap.md pointer and the lane line
value.success: skills/pij/references/community/workstream.md teaches shape, split, merge, nest, lanes and coverage and defines workstream and pij stream so they never overlap; roadmap.md points at it; the community README, prd.md, fold-a-ruling.md, the route, protocol.md and orient-oprime.md follow.

value.title: PRD 001 and blueprint 001 wording and rows
value.success: req-04, 18, 20, 21, 23, 24 and 27 say workstream; req-30 (nesting and lanes) and req-31 (coverage check) are added; c-doc-schemas names pij/workstream and realises req-30; each doc gets a changelog row.

value.title: v3 of the six core templates
value.success: pm, coder, pa, prime, reviewer and security ship v3 with workstream wording; v1 and v2 bytes unchanged; SHIPPED and the sha256 pins carry v3; the templates README links v3.

value.title: Umbrella roll-up check (phase 2, coder)
value.success: A check fails when an umbrella step is complete while a step that is part_of it is not. ddocs has no cross-row rule, so the phase 2 coverage sensor (req-31, AC6) holds it.

value.title: AC4 remainder: coverage links for req-26 and PRD 002
value.success: req-26 gains a delivering step (s17 in workstream 001); PRD 002's 14 rows get blueprint 002 and workstream 002; the 15 coverage exemptions and APPROVED_EXEMPTIONS are emptied, so coverage-check covers every row with no exemption.

tk-0001.assertion: ddocs validate passes the umbrella and child fixtures (cross-file part_of and depends_on, lanes with a stream) and fails workstream-lane-no-branch (missing branch) and workstream-part-of-missing (no s09) by name; ddocs links lists the child's part_of on the umbrella step.

tk-0002.assertion: bash harness/scripts/pij-skill-check.sh is all green; roadmap.md is a one-line pointer to workstream.md; the route stays within 100 lines.

tk-0003.assertion: ddocs validate is 0/0 and ddocs build regenerates the .dd.md for PRD 001 and blueprint 001; just ddocs-check passes. Zero undelivered rows waits on the phase 2 sensor (req-30 and req-31 need s16).

tk-0004.assertion: cargo test -p pij-daemon --lib community::templates (pins and embedding), the directory_http templates tests and skill_verb_coverage pass; ddocs validate is 0/0 on each v3; a structural diff of v2 to v3 shows only wording, the version, the changelog row and, for pm, one shaping rule and its summary.

tk-0005.assertion: An umbrella step marked complete with an open child fails a check. ddocs has no cross-row rule, so this moves to the phase 2 coverage sensor (req-31, AC6).

tk-0011.assertion: ddocs validate passes; coverage-check reports zero undelivered requirements and zero unbuilt components on main after #162, with no exemptions.
